Coerce a pxweb_data object to a data.frame

Source: R/pxweb_as_data_frame.R
pxweb_as_data_frame.Rd

Coerce a pxweb_data object to a data.frame

Usage

pxweb_as_data_frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  ...,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  column.name.type = "text",
  variable.value.type = "text"
)
